# Synthetic speech fixtures

These mono PCM16 WAVs were generated locally with Windows System.Speech TTS.
They contain no microphone recordings or personal data:

- letter_b.wav: "bee"
- letter_c.wav: "sea"
- letter_z.wav: "zed"
- unrelated.wav: "hello everyone"

They check real Vosk inference, confidence and unknown/silence rejection.
They do not certify child speech, every letter, microphone hardware or Pi audio.
